speedtest_url_hint: Base URL of your Speedtest Tracker instance
speedtest_token_hint: Bearer token from Speedtest Tracker settings
speedtest_tls_insecure_hint: Skip TLS certificate verification for self-signed HTTPS certificates
booked_download_hint: Contracted download speed in Mbps for health calculation
booked_upload_hint: Contracted upload speed in Mbps for health calculation
speedtest_setup_intro: Speedtest Tracker is a self-hosted app that runs periodic Ookla speed tests. DOCSight can display your speed test results alongside modem signal data for a complete picture of your connection.
speedtest_setup_benefit_1: Track actual download/upload speeds over time
speedtest_setup_benefit_2: Correlate speed drops with DOCSIS signal issues
speedtest_setup_benefit_3: Independent proof of speed issues for ISP complaints
speedtest_setup_guided_intro: Connect your existing Speedtest Tracker instance so DOCSight can correlate real throughput with modem signal health.
speedtest_setup_requirement_api: API access enabled in Speedtest Tracker
speedtest_setup_configure_text: Paste the Speedtest Tracker base URL in Settings, then save the integration.
speedtest_setup_validate_text: Use Settings to save the URL, then confirm DOCSight can read recent speed test results.
speedtest_setup_validation_path: Speedtest can be tested in Speedtest settings after the base URL and API token are saved. DOCSight uses the saved credentials for the live connection test.
clear_cache_confirm: Clear all cached speedtest results? They will be re-synced on the next poll cycle.
speedtest_setup_step_2: In Speedtest Tracker, go to Settings → API and create an API token
speedtest_setup_step_3: Paste your Speedtest Tracker URL and API token in DOCSight Settings
speedtest_timeout: Speedtest is taking longer than expected. Refresh to check.
speedtest_empty_desc: Automated tests will appear here once the schedule runs. You can also start a manual test.
clear_cache_hint: Delete cached results and re-sync from Speedtest Tracker
speedtest_empty_period_text: There are older results outside the selected period.
